theorem MvPolynomial.index_le_of_abs_leadingCoeff_le {p q : ℤ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hco : IsCoprime p q) {d : ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) {P : Polynomial ℤ} (hP : P ≠ 0) (e : ℕ) (hB : |P.leadingCoeff| ≤ q ^ e) :
index (fun (x : Unit) => d) (fun (x : Unit) => ↑p / ↑q) ((pUnitAlgEquiv ℚ).symm (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ ℚ) P)) ≤ ↑(↑e / ↑d)

theorem MvPolynomial.index_le_of_pow_abs_leadingCoeff_le {p q : ℤ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hco : IsCoprime p q) {d : ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) {P : Polynomial ℤ} (hP : P ≠ 0) {Qe S : ℕ} (hQe : Qe ≠ 0) (hB : |P.leadingCoeff| ^ Qe ≤ q ^ S) :
index (fun (x : Unit) => d) (fun (x : Unit) => ↑p / ↑q) ((pUnitAlgEquiv ℚ).symm (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ ℚ) P)) ≤ ↑(↑S / (↑Qe * ↑d))

theorem MvPolynomial.index_le_of_pow_abs_coeff_le {p q : ℤ} (hq0 : 0 < q) (hco : IsCoprime p q) {d : ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) {P : Polynomial ℤ} (hP : P ≠ 0) {Qe S : ℕ} (hQe : Qe ≠ 0) {a : ℤ} (hH : 2 ≤ max |p| |q|) (ha : ∀ (n : ℕ), |P.coeff n| ≤ a) (hae : a ^ Qe ≤ max |p| |q| ^ S) :
index (fun (x : Unit) => d) (fun (x : Unit) => ↑p / ↑q) ((pUnitAlgEquiv ℚ).symm (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ ℚ) P)) ≤ ↑(↑S / (↑Qe * ↑d))

theorem MvPolynomial.index_le_of_abs_coeff_le {p q : ℤ} (hq0 : 0 < q) (hco : IsCoprime p q) {d : ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) {P : Polynomial ℤ} (hP : P ≠ 0) (e : ℕ) {a : ℤ} (hH : 2 ≤ max |p| |q|) (ha : ∀ (n : ℕ), |P.coeff n| ≤ a) (hae : a ≤ max |p| |q| ^ e) :
index (fun (x : Unit) => d) (fun (x : Unit) => ↑p / ↑q) ((pUnitAlgEquiv ℚ).symm (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ ℚ) P)) ≤ ↑(↑e / ↑d)

theorem MvPolynomial.exists_index_eq_div_and_height_pow_le {p q : ℤ} (hq0 : 0 < q) (hco : IsCoprime p q) {d : ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) {P : Polynomial ℤ} (hP : P ≠ 0) :
∃ (n₀ : ℕ), index (fun (x : Unit) => d) (fun (x : Unit) => ↑p / ↑q) ((pUnitAlgEquiv ℚ).symm (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ ℚ) P)) = ↑(↑n₀ / ↑d) ∧ max |p| |q| ^ n₀ ≤ max |P.trailingCoeff| |P.leadingCoeff|

theorem MvPolynomial.exists_index_eq_div_and_pow_le {p q : ℤ} (hq0 : 0 < q) (hco : IsCoprime p q) {d : ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) {P : Polynomial ℤ} (hP : P ≠ 0) :
∃ (n₀ : ℕ), index (fun (x : Unit) => d) (fun (x : Unit) => ↑p / ↑q) ((pUnitAlgEquiv ℚ).symm (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ ℚ) P)) = ↑(↑n₀ / ↑d) ∧ q ^ n₀ ≤ |P.leadingCoeff|

theorem MvPolynomial.taylor_coeff_eq_zero_of_index_eq {p q : ℤ} {d : ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) {P : Polynomial ℤ} {n₀ : ℕ} (hidx : index (fun (x : Unit) => d) (fun (x : Unit) => ↑p / ↑q) ((pUnitAlgEquiv ℚ).symm (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ ℚ) P)) = ↑(↑n₀ / ↑d)) (n : ℕ) :
n < n₀ → ((Polynomial.taylor (↑p / ↑q)) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ ℚ) P)).coeff n = 0

theorem MvPolynomial.exists_index_eq_div {d : ℕ} {P : Polynomial ℤ} (hP : P ≠ 0) (α : ℚ) :
∃ (n₀ : ℕ), index (fun (x : Unit) => d) (fun (x : Unit) => α) ((pUnitAlgEquiv ℚ).symm (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ ℚ) P)) = ↑(↑n₀ / ↑d)

theorem MvPolynomial.pow_le_abs_leadingCoeff_of_le_index {p q : ℤ} (hq : 0 < q) (hco : IsCoprime p q) {d : ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) {P : Polynomial ℤ} (hP : P ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) (h : ↑(↑k / ↑d) ≤ index (fun (x : Unit) => d) (fun (x : Unit) => ↑p / ↑q) ((pUnitAlgEquiv ℚ).symm (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ ℚ) P))) :
q ^ k ≤ |P.leadingCoeff|

theorem MvPolynomial.taylor_coeff_eq_zero_of_le_index {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {d : ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) (α : R) (Q : MvPolynomial Unit R) (k n : ℕ) (h : ↑(↑k / ↑d) ≤ index (fun (x : Unit) => d) (fun (x : Unit) => α) Q) (hn : n < k) :
((Polynomial.taylor α) ((pUnitAlgEquiv R) Q)).coeff n = 0

theorem MvPolynomial.pUnitAlgEquiv_translate {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (α : R) (Q : MvPolynomial Unit R) :
(pUnitAlgEquiv R) (translate (fun (x : PUnit.{1}) => α) Q) = (Polynomial.taylor α) ((pUnitAlgEquiv R) Q)

theorem MvPolynomial.coeff_pUnitAlgEquiv {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (Q : MvPolynomial Unit R) (n : ℕ) :
((pUnitAlgEquiv R) Q).coeff n = coeff (Finsupp.single () n) Q
